text:
Maria: FYI seeing intermittent timeouts on east-west traffic for two GPU training jobs in us-west-2 over the last hour :rotating_light:
Ajay: same here, logs show bursts of packet loss between nodes in gpu-pool-3, not constant but spikes of ~10-30s.
Taylor: ran iperf3 and pings between node-17 and node-22 (same AZ) — throughput ok but occasional 1-3% packet loss bursts, RTT spikes from 0.6ms -> 12-30ms.
Chris: net-bot dump from node-22:
net-bot: iface=vxlan0 tx_dropped=87 rx_dropped=63 GSO_skb_errs=18 tso_skipped=5
Ajay: GSO/GRO errors. Any recent NIC fw/kernel updates in that pool?
Sam: we rolled a batch last night: mlx5 fw 23.20 and kernel 5.19 on those machines.
Taylor: tcpdump during one event shows retransmits and some out-of-order packets once flows increase to larger MSS. Small flows unaffected.
Maria: pods are using the default overlay CNI (geneve) with SNAT. No RDMA for these GPU jobs.
Chris: hypothesis: offload (GSO/TSO) + vxlan encapsulation bug on mlx5 driver causing skb issues and tx_drops, aggravated by ECMP path changes.
Ajay: can we test toggling off GSO/TSO on one node to validate?
Taylor: tested on node-22: ethtool -K eth0 gso off gro off tso off — after that the 30s loss bursts stopped for the 25m run. Re-enabled and bursts returned.
Sam: that pretty much pins it to offload + overlay interaction.
Maria: impact: training steps pause/retry, slightly higher overall job runtime. Not a cluster-wide outage but visible and customer-impacting.
Ajay: mitigation options: revert kernel/fw (slow), disable offloads on affected pool (fast), schedule hostNetwork nodes for latency-sensitive jobs (works but consumes IPs), or pin pods to rack-local nodes to avoid ECMP.
Taylor: hostNetwork test removed overlay issues entirely for same job, lower latency, but requires IP planning.
Chris: propose canary: disable GSO on 2 nodes in gpu-pool-3 and run synthetic training for 6h overnight. If stable, roll to pool.
Sam: vendor notes a fix in fw 24.x + driver updates on kernel 5.20+. We'll coordinate a proper upgrade after canary.
Ajay: also adding monitoring: alert if vxlan0.tx_dropped > 20 in 5m, and surface GSO_skb_errs as a metric.
Maria: add runbook steps and the exact ethtool commands to the incident playbook. Also notify support so they can reschedule or move customer jobs if they see errors.
Taylor: when we disable offloads, CPU overhead increased ~5% in our tests but training throughput change negligible for these workloads.
Chris: quick rollback commands for canary nodes: ethtool -K eth0 gso on gro on tso on and remove taint.
devops-bot: created ticket INFRA-4921 and scheduled canary for 02:30 UTC.
net-bot: captured pcap and ethtool dumps attached to INFRA-4921.
Sam: reminder: watch conntrack — NAT + retries could grow conntrack table; we measured stable counts during tests but keep an eye.
Maria: summary: intermittent overlay packet loss traced to vxlan + NIC offload interaction on newer mlx5/kernel combo. Short-term mitigation: disable GSO on affected nodes and roll canary. Long-term: schedule firmware/driver upgrade with vendor fix.
Taylor: will add iperf logs, pcap, ethtool and kernel/module versions to the ticket for postmortem.
Maria: thanks team, keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
